description: Read a single secret from an absolute file path (entire file contents as the value) and store it (encrypted at rest). Optionally strips trailing whitespace. Useful for private keys, certificates, and other multi-line credentials that don't survive copy-paste.
embedding_description: Store secret from a file. Ingest credential, load private key, persist signing key, single-value file as secret. Agent supplies absolute file path plus vault key; the solet reads whole file (optionally rstripped) as one secret. Use for SSH private keys, X.509 certificates, GPG keys, JWT signing keys, multi-line tokens. Variants: store_from_env, store_from_kv_file, store_from_keychain.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that file contents were read, encrypted, and stored. Contains key (vault identifier), version, and message. NEVER contains the secret value.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads the entire contents of a file as a single secret and stores it in the vault. The agent never sees the file contents.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: file_path_not_absolute: file_path argument must be an absolute path. file_not_found: No file at the supplied path. file_unreadable: File exists but cannot be read (permissions, encoding). file_empty: File is empty after optional strip. VaultLocked: Vault must be unlocked first.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For file_path_not_absolute: ask the user to provide an absolute path (e.g. /path/to/key.pem, not ~/.ssh/key.pem). For file_not_found / file_unreadable: confirm the path and the readability for the solet's user. For file_empty: confirm the file actually contains the secret. For VaultLocked: prompt the user to unlock the vault first.
